name: fold-pre-edit-of-the-decomposed-spelling-meets-the-holder-where-the-disk-folds-accents
description: Session A takes EXCLUSIVE on data/café.txt (composed e-acute); session B then pre-edits data/café.txt (e plus a combining acute). APFS folds the two forms whether or not it folds case, so on caseless and nfd B meets A's hold with the collision warning, which echoes B's decomposed spelling. A disk that folds nothing (none) keeps them apart and B gets the plain {ok: true}: no collision. Both spellings are listed in tracked.yaml, so the decomposed one is tracked on every disk by its own literal pattern; on none this row cannot tell that admission from an untracked one, which answers the same {ok: true}. Both backends.
